capabilities: Import .pilgrim exports as one Markdown note per walk
Write walk stats, celestial data and weather into namespaced frontmatter
Link waypoints and place names as wiki-links for graph clustering
Generate a Dataview dashboard note of walk tables
Embed interactive route maps from GeoJSON sidecars
disambiguation: Not a GPS tracking or route-planning tool; it only imports existing Pilgrim walk exports into Obsidian.
extras: Not yet in the community-plugin directory (manual install). The README warns that the Mapbox token is written into notes and data.json, so it travels with the vault and should have a usage cap set.
problem: Pilgrim walk records and their voice-reflection transcriptions stay locked in a separate app instead of being searchable, linkable text in the vault.

relations.evidence: Waymark imports a .pilgrim export and turns each walk into a Markdown note
Install the Dataview community plugin to render them.
Install the obsidian-leaflet community plugin — it draws the map.
Place names come from OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service

summary: Pilgrim walk importer that turns .pilgrim exports into Markdown notes with transcribed voice reflections, stats, waypoints, weather and an optional route map.
